production.note: Global Series 2 production, all engines. Magneto: the Series 2 'arrived in time for the 2001 model year' and the Series 3 was introduced for the 2011 model year. Rover K-series engines at first; Toyota engines from 2004. Sold in the US from model year 2005, Toyota-engined only. Sources disagree on the exact years, see discrepancies.

body.note: Two-seat mid-engined roadster with a removable soft top; Edmunds lists a 2-door roadster/convertible

configuration.note: Toyota 2ZZ-GE in the US-market car. 2001-2004 cars for Europe used the Rover K-series I4 instead.

displacementL.note: 1.8-litre Toyota four-cylinder (US-market 2005 car). Rover K-series cars were also 1.8 litres per PistonHeads.

aspiration.note: US-market 2005 car. No forced induction is mentioned; supercharged S2 models (e.g. Elise SC) came later and are not covered by these figures.

transmission.note: Toyota-sourced 6-speed in the US-market car. Rover-engined S2 cars used a 5-speed manual (PistonHeads); not listed because the record describes the US 2005 car.

powerHp.note: US-market 2005 Elise: 190 hp (at 7,800 rpm per Edmunds and Cars.com). No Lotus press document was found; the figure is the manufacturer rating as printed by MotorWeek. The UK 111R with the same engine is quoted at 189 hp; Rover-engined S2 cars made far less (e.g. 134 hp Sport 135).

weightLb.note: US-market 2005 Elise curb weight as listed by Edmunds and Cars.com (both databases); MotorWeek only says 'under 2,000 pounds'. Single transmission and body, so no lighter standard configuration. UK cars were lighter (PistonHeads: 860 kg for the Toyota-engined 111R, 825 kg for a K-series Sport 135).

sources.title: Lotus Elise S2: PH used buying guide

discrepancies.reason: Sources draw the Series 2 boundaries differently: model year vs calendar year for the start, and whether the 2010 facelift (sold as the 2011 model year) ends the Series 2 in 2009 or 2010.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 2001-2010 from Magneto (S2 from the 2001 model year, Series 3 from the 2011 model year). Not confirmed by a Lotus source; covered by the review flag.

discrepancies.reason: 190 hp is the US-market 2005 rating; 189 hp is the UK 111R with the same Toyota 2ZZ-GE (PS/bhp rounding); 134 hp is the Rover K-series Sport 135. The Series 2 covered several engines.
discrepancies.resolution: Used the US-market 2005 figure per the spec basis.

discrepancies.reason: 1,975 lb is the US-market 2005 car; 860 kg (1,896 lb) is the UK 111R, which lacks US-market equipment.
discrepancies.resolution: Used the US-market figure per the spec basis.

reviewNotes: The Series 2 probably needs splitting into several records: it ran from 2001 with Rover K-series engines (5-speed; e.g. the 134 hp Sport 135 per PistonHeads), switched to Toyota engines in 2004 (111R / US Elise, 6-speed) and later included a supercharged SC model (mentioned by Magneto). This record describes only the US-market 2005 Elise (Toyota 2ZZ-GE, 190 hp), while the production years cover the whole Series 2. Also: curb weight relies on databases (Edmunds, Cars.com) because no Lotus document or publication spec panel with an exact US figure could be opened; production years are not confirmed by a Lotus source and the sources disagree (2001/2002 start, 2009/2010 end).
